children: On November 23, 2026, Dermata Therapeutics received notice that it failed to meet Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2), which requires a minimum bid price of $1.00 per share, after its closing bid price remained below that threshold for 30 consecutive business days. The company has until May 24, 2027, to regain compliance; the notice does not immediately affect its Nasdaq listing, and a second 180-day compliance period may be available if it meets the applicable requirements.
